d: Are Indian roads becoming increasingly unsafe for women? Two disturbing road rage incidents in Lucknow and Gurugram have raised fresh questions about women’s safety, road rage and public safety in India. In Lucknow, a woman was filmed clinging to the bonnet of a moving car after an altercation with the driver. Police said the woman and the driver knew each other, and the woman was injured in the incident.
